summary: Ran full backend pytest (10/10 passed) and comprehensive frontend Playwright flow. Backend APIs (auth, dashboard, clients, leads, projects, tasks, logout) all work correctly when required fields are provided. Frontend had a CRITICAL redirect loop (401 interceptor auto-redirecting during initial /auth/me probe on Login page) which I fixed. After the fix: login, dashboard rendering, all 11 sidebar nav links, header user info + logout, and register page all work. However, the Frontend Add-Client and New-Project modals FAIL silently because the frontend forms omit backend-required Pydantic fields (organization_id, owner_id), producing 422 responses that are swallowed by console.error - modal stays open and creation fails from the UI.

critical.issue: Pydantic requires 'organization_id' but backend overwrites it after validation. Frontend does not send it → 422. Make organization_id Optional in Client model (or use a create-request model).
Requires 'owner_id' AND 'organization_id' via Pydantic but backend overrides both after validation. Frontend doesn't send them → 422.

minor.issue: Also requires organization_id in body (frontend Leads UI not built yet, but same pattern will bite when it is).
Task model requires reporter_id/organization_id — same pattern; will affect any UI task-create form.

ui_bugs.issue: POST /clients returns 422 because form omits organization_id. Modal never closes; no user-facing error toast is shown (only console.error).
POST /projects returns 422 (missing owner_id, organization_id). Modal doesn't close; no error UI.
data-testid is 'header-logout-button' but testIds.js AUTH.logoutButton = 'logout-button' — inconsistent naming. Not blocking, but confusing.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend must send organization_id (and owner_id for projects), or backend Client/Project models must mark these Optional so the endpoint's defaulting logic (`user.organization_id or 'default'`) actually runs.

issues: Dark theme renders cleanly, Outfit/Manrope fonts load, layout is well-spaced. No contrast issues observed.

action_items: Make Client.organization_id, Project.owner_id, Project.organization_id Optional[str]=None in /app/backend/models.py (or add dedicated *CreateRequest models). Same for Task, Lead, Document to prevent future bugs.
Add user-facing error toast / setError state to CRM.handleCreateClient and Projects.handleCreateProject so failures are surfaced instead of only console.error.
Consider adding a global axios error toast for non-401 failures.
Optionally clean up logout-button testId mismatch between Header.js and constants/testIds.js.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js 401 interceptor caused an infinite redirect loop on /login because initial /auth/me probe returns 401. Fixed by excluding /auth/me and skipping redirect when already on /login or /register.
server.py sets organization_id / owner_id AFTER Pydantic validation — inputs must be Optional or a separate request schema should be used.
AuthProvider unconditionally calls /auth/me on mount; consider skipping when no token in localStorage to avoid extra 401s.
Missing input models: reusing full DB models as request bodies leaks required internal fields to the API surface.
No global error boundary or toast on failed writes.

success_rate.frontend: 80% - core flows work, create-client & create-project fail

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed clients/leads/projects/tasks and one TEST_ user via /auth/register; no cleanup implemented — safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend 401 interceptor was patched (see api.js). After main agent makes org_id/owner_id Optional in models.py and rebuilds, retest CRM Add Client and Projects New Project flows — they should then close the modal and show the new record.
rca of the issue: 1) Redirect loop RCA: api.js response interceptor invoked window.location.href='/login' on ANY 401, including the AuthProvider's mount-time /auth/me probe which naturally returns 401 for unauthenticated users. Because the redirect target was the same /login route, each mount re-triggered the probe → infinite reload loop; the login form flashed once then vanished. Fix: skip redirect for /auth/me and when already on /login|/register. 2) Client/Project create RCA: server.py routes accept the raw DB Pydantic model (Client, Project) which requires organization_id/owner_id. The endpoints then overwrite those fields from `user` — but Pydantic validation runs before the handler body, so requests missing these fields are rejected with 422 before defaults can be applied. Frontend forms don't send them → creation always fails. Fix: mark organization_id, owner_id Optional[str]=None in models.py OR introduce separate ClientCreate / ProjectCreate request schemas.
